caption: The drawing depicts an object that resembles a carved botanical form, possibly an acorn or pinecone, set against a plain, light beige background. The object itself is rendered in shades of light brown with darker brown lines accentuating its carved texture, highlighting the grooves and contours. The lower section features large, petal-like forms curving outward, while the upper section is more conical, with overlapping, scale-like segments. The surface shows indications of wood grain and some irregularities, suggesting a wooden texture. There are small patches of green-blue discoloration near the base, which contrast with the otherwise monochromatic brown color scheme. The composition is centered, with the singular object occupying most of the available space.
title: Base for Weather Vane
